Rust web framework comparison

Comparison of Rust web frameworks — Axum, Actix Web, Rocket, Warp — with routing, middleware, and performance notes.

Rocket - A stable and fast Rust web framework

Rocket is a stable and fast web framework for the Rust programming language with a simple and expressive API.

warp - ergonomic, compact async web framework

warp is an ergonomic, compact async web framework for the Rust programming language, built on top of tokio and hyper.
